property.materializeHelp: Reported properties are stored in the properties JSON by default and parsed on every query. Materializing adds a dedicated ClickHouse column (prefixed with p_) so queries read the column instead of the JSON. For now, Materialize only generates the DDL; it does not alter the table automatically.

event.title: Events
event.hint: Click an event row to view details; use the filters above and the batch actions to govern events.
event.searchPlaceholder: Search event name, display name, or notes

tooltip.availability: Available = has data and is visible; No data = no data in the last 7 days; Hidden = hidden or deleted; Deprecated = status is pending or deprecated.
tooltip.dataStatus: Normal = had data yesterday; No data yesterday = had data in the last 7 days but not yesterday; No recent data = no data in the last 7 days.
tooltip.connection: Auto-discovered = reported events discovered automatically; Virtual source = aggregated from a virtual event definition; Preset = system preset event.

eventAttribute.title: Event attributes
eventAttribute.statusHelp: Pending: auto-discovered from reported data and not yet confirmed by a human. Enabled: confirmed and usable in analysis. Hidden: not recommended for governance; the custom SQL dictionary no longer lists it, though event analysis filters may still show it. This filter only affects this list and does not change reported data.
eventAttribute.searchPlaceholder: Search property key, display name, or notes

userProperty.title: User properties
userProperty.hint: Manage user-level property metadata. Edit the display name in the details panel; it takes effect after you save.

virtualEvent.title: Virtual events
virtualEvent.deleteConfirm: This virtual event can no longer be selected in analysis after deletion. Delete it?

virtualProperty.title: Virtual properties
virtualProperty.expressionHelp: Use $prop_key to reference event attributes; supports + - * / %, > < ==, && ||, if/concat/length/toString/round
virtualProperty.keyPattern: Must start with vp_ and be a valid identifier

debug.title: Debug live query
debug.alertTitle: View raw reported events from sa_events within the selected time range, to verify tracking integration
debug.alertDesc: Provide at least one condition; the default range is the last 24 hours (1 hour / 24 hours / 7 days), up to 100 rows
debug.needCondition: Provide at least one query condition (distinct_id / user_key / event name)
debug.empty: No matching data (check the conditions and whether data was reported in the selected range)
debug.statDateNotice: To let the time condition prune partitions, the query also applies stat_date >= start date - 2 days; rows whose device clock is off by more than 2 days are not included
debug.slowHint: Device / account lookups are slow; adding an event name helps a lot (it hits the index)
debug.archiveSaved: This result was archived; review it under History below
debug.archiveFailed: This result was not archived (save failed; the query result is unaffected)
debug.archiveDisabled: Archiving is disabled for this project; this result will not be saved
debug.archiveTruncated: This record is incomplete (content exceeded the limit and was truncated)
debug.deleteConfirm: Delete this record? This cannot be undone
debug.archiveSwitchHint: When on, query results are saved automatically (kept forever, deletable one by one)
debug.handoff: The query is slow, so it continues in the background ({{seconds}}s elapsed); the result will appear here when ready
debug.handoffSlow: Still running in the background; check History below later
debug.errorTimeout: The background query timed out (budget exhausted); narrow the time range and try again
debug.errorQueryFailed: The background query failed; try again later or narrow the time range
